position_eligibility: target-question × requested-sensor whose A0 is correct in both Main and Alternative; absolute rates at both positions use the same paired set
C1_eligibility: the common A0-correct-both-position set intersected with the frozen second-congruent-assigned subset
position_sign: slot 2 minus slot 1; optical Alternative−Main, SAR Main−Alternative
opposite_replicates: three replicates averaged within each eligible target-question × requested-sensor × position

bootstrap.resampling_unit: physical target source; only eligible question-level records travel with the source
bootstrap.zero_denominator_policy: retain as invalid and report count; no replacement draw

qwen3b_reuse_audit: native frozen adapter/runner and outer wrapper are recorded as separate identity layers; blank legacy top-level adapter metadata is not interpreted as a mismatch
llava_bridge_audit: bridge_dir null is not proof of nonexistence; use available archived evidence or report unable to authenticate
interpretation: all endpoints remain exploratory pointwise results; Qwen3 [0,0] is empirical bootstrap degeneracy, not proof of an exactly zero population effect
